coordinator_summary: Critical QA failure. Agent Sam demonstrated severely deficient customer service by refusing to check the patient's file, declining to provide a callback number for follow-up, and offering no timeline or alternative resolution after the patient had already waited two weeks. While the patient was exemplary in tone and cooperation, the agent's lack of empathy (1/10) and professionalism (2/10) resulted in a completely unresolved outcome. The issue was not addressed (2/10), and crucially, the patient was left with zero clarity on next steps (1/10). This call violates basic service standards and requires agent retraining on patient advocacy and available resources.
